title: plugin-auth: SCIM-driven writes leave sys_audit_log rows with actor, user_id and metadata null, so no audit row names the SCIM connection that acted
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a contract gap with a named consumer**, measured by the cloud#3667 dev on a real licensed objectos-ee serve (report on objectstack-ai/cloud#3667, Enterprise SCIM leaver lifecycle; draft PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3672). Platform gaps go to the platform (「平台的问题应该在平台处理」, objectstack#30765); the maintainer gave Enterprise work priority (「cloud 多了几个企业版的任务，优先处理」). Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3667 (live Okta / Entra ID provisioning). Second consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3665 (the Enterprise audit export needs attributable rows).

## 维护者速读

IdP 通过 SCIM 开通、停用或删除用户时，平台会写审计记录，但这些记录的「谁做的」一栏是空的，看不出是哪个 SCIM 连接（哪个 IdP）干的。审计员因此没法追溯离职员工是被谁停用的。需要让这类记录标明 SCIM 连接。

## Measured (cloud pin `2ffdb649` on the serve)

- Every SCIM-driven `sys_audit_log` row (the `sys_user` create, the deactivation's ban update, `sys_member`, `sys_scim_*`) has `actor`, `user_id` and `metadata` all null. Read from the SQLite store after a licensed boot; parked as `it.skip` in cloud#3672.
- The verifier `verifyScimBearerToken` resolves a connection, but nothing carries that principal into the writes' audit context.

## Expected

- SCIM writes are attributed to the connection as a service principal: `actor` in the existing `svc:<name>` form or a SCIM-specific one (the lane decides, and follows the incumbent shape), with the connection id in `metadata`. `user_id` stays null, because no human acted.
- Same for the ban update a deactivation writes, so "who deactivated this account" has an answer.

## Acceptance

- Tests: a SCIM create, a deactivation and a delete each write rows whose actor names the connection; the rows never carry the bearer.

Suggested-grade: p1 · Enterprise priority (maintainer).

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `SCIM audit actor` → 29 hits, top 4 closed and unrelated; `sys_audit_log actor null` → 64 hits (#30955 open is export; #27539, #27414, #26474 closed, the same null-actor class on other writers). None covers SCIM.
